errors.text_span: steigt dann kontinuierlich bis 2010 auf etwa 1,03
errors.evidence: The description states that the purple line (Totale Faktorproduktivität) peaks at approximately 1.03 in the year 2010. However, the chart clearly shows that the peak occurs in the year 2011.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei etwa 30 im Jahr 1995, bleibt bis 1999 bei etwa 28, steigt dann bis 2003 auf etwa 37
errors.evidence: The description of the blue line (Investitionsquote) contains multiple significant numerical errors. In 1995, the value is approximately 32, not 30. In 1999, the value is also approximately 32, not 28; the line never drops below 30. In 2003, the value is approximately 39, not 37.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis 2019 leicht auf etwa 0,98 sinkt
errors.evidence: The description states that the purple line (Totale Faktorproduktivität) sinks to approximately 0.98 by 2019. The value in 2019 is visibly higher, at approximately 0.99. The value of 0.98 is reached in the year 2020.
